groups.disposition: Rendered endpoints and rotations are collected and all checked before endpoint-field replacement. Owner projections are filtered finite; locomotion retains endpoints but declines procedural contact authority. Enabled terrain needs sampled ankle and surface; disabled mode explicitly owns semantic cadence. Run support requires intended target proximity plus actual sole height. Transition and reported weights remain distinct intentionally. Sequence observer admits only same/one wrapping step, not arbitrary stale plan reset.

Pole projection normalizes fallibly; near-horizontal leg rejects vertical reconstruction. Slope tilt capped, cached chains distinguish repeated evaluation. Toe-off starts from propagated orientation; angular step zero retains previous when present, initial missing previous deliberately adopts desired. Final anatomy pass measures segments and reports actual resulting yaw. Native quaternion normalization assumes usable magnitude: zero/extreme finite raw quaternion inputs remain a dependency requiring exact native semantics and actual producer proof, not an ordinary defect established here. No global unit-quaternion admission imposed on ObservedRigFrame.

Absent cannot become acquired from observation alone. Target replacement preserves acquisition state when a target remains and clears state on None. observe_contact(false) intentionally does not revoke acquisition by itself; actual release/clear ownership traced in coordinator 404 and observation refresh. These bodies do not prove whole-frame transactional rollback.
